title: Impacts of real microplastic leachates on the development and behavior of developing zebrafish (Danio rerio)
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, 27,3148-3162
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00415B, Paper
Emma Tsai, Melanie Wilson, Mohamed Ateia, Ahmed Abdelmoneim
Plastic pollution in aquatic environments has increased, raising concerns about the toxicity of microplastics (MPs) and their leachates to developing organisms.
